caption: Every missed call is a customer who just called the next name on Google. If your phone could text them back before the second ring, how many of those jobs would you keep?

slides.headline: You lost a job this week and didn't even know it
Someone called. You were busy.
slides.body: Under a car. On a roof. With a client. It rang out.

slides.headline: They called the next name on Google.
slides.body: That job is gone. You never saw it leave.

slides.headline: What if your phone texted back first?
slides.body: Before the second ring. Every time. Without you touching it.

slides.headline: Same customer. Different ending.
slides.body: They get a reply, you get the job, and you never put the tools down.
